description: This file contains the implementation of a generic ReadWriteLock class used for transaction synchronization within the Orleans framework. It manages lock acquisition, validation, conflict resolution, and timeout handling for transactions, with internal classes for lock grouping. The code interfaces with Orleans-specific transaction and configuration constructs, indicating its role in transactional state management.

classes.name: ReadWriteLock
classes.description: A generic class implementing line-based transaction locking with support for conflict resolution, timeouts, and lock grouping, tailored for Orleans transactional state management.

classes.name: LockGroup
classes.description: An internal linked list node grouping transactions that share conflicting lock states, supporting batch operations and timeout management.

methods.name: EnterLock
methods.description: Asynchronously acquires a lock for a transaction, supporting nested re-entry, conflict detection, and task scheduling.

methods.name: ValidateLock
methods.description: Validates the lock's current state against an access counter; may trigger rollback if validation fails.

methods.name: Notify
methods.description: Signals the lock worker to reevaluate lock state.

methods.name: TryGetRecord
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the transaction record for a given transaction ID.

methods.name: AbortExecutingTransactions
methods.description: Aborts all ongoing transactions in the current lock group, signaling failure due to an exception.

methods.name: AbortQueuedTransactions
methods.description: Aborts all waiting transactions in the queue, typically on lock timeout or shutdown.

methods.name: Rollback
methods.description: Removes a transaction record from the current group, optionally notifying abort.
